Let the three points be
\[
P_1=(x_1,y_1),\quad P_2=(x_2,y_2),\quad P_3=(x_3,y_3).
\]
The given equations say
\[
P_1P_2=3,\qquad P_1P_3=4,\qquad P_2P_3=5.
\]
So the triangle formed by the three points has side lengths \(3,4,5\), a right triangle.

Its area is therefore
\[
\text{Area}=\frac12\cdot 3\cdot 4=6.
\]
The determinant
\[
\begin{vmatrix}
x_1&y_1&1\\
x_2&y_2&1\\
x_3&y_3&1
\end{vmatrix}
\]
equals twice the signed area of the triangle. Hence its square is
\[
(2\cdot 6)^2=12^2=144.
\]

The answer is 144.
